Headline: #6 Jackson Park Express Temporary Northbound Reroute near Stetson/Lake
ShortDescription: Northbound 6 Jackson Park Express buses are temporarily rerouted, due to street blockage near Stetson/Lake.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Northbound #6 Jackson Park Express buses are temporarily rerouted via Michigan, Randolph, Columbus, Wacker and sit layover, due to street blockage near Stetson/Lake.

Southbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Green and Orange Line Delays
ShortDescription: Green and Orange Line trains are running w/residual delays following an earlier medical emergency on the tracks at Roosevelt. Service is resuming.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green and Orange Line trains are running w/residual delays and congestion following an earlier medical emergency on the tracks at Roosevelt.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Bus shuttles are available in both directions, for the following, until 8:45pm:

Green Line: 35th to Adams/Wabash
Orange Line: Halsted to H.W. Library

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #22 Clark and #152 Addison Temporary Reroute near  Clark/Addison
ShortDescription: 22 Clark and 152 Addison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Clark/Addison.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#22 Clark and #152 Addison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near Clark/Addison.

#22 Clark buses will operate via Clark, Racine, Belmont, then resume their normal route on Clark.

#152 Addison buses will operate via Addison, Racine, Belmont, Halsted, then resume their normal route on Addison.

Allow extra travel time.
